tools.name: stream_get_app
tools.description: Fetch the Stream app's settings and configured channel types. Good first call to confirm credentials and discover available channel types. GET /api/v2/app.

tools.name: stream_query_channels
tools.description: List/filter channels by a Stream query filter. e.g. filter {"type":"messaging"} or {"members":{"$in":["user-1"]}}. Returns channels with recent state. POST /api/v2/chat/channels.

tools.name: stream_get_channel
tools.description: Fetch a single channel's state (config, members) and its most recent messages. Note: uses Stream's get-or-create endpoint — for an existing channel it reads; if the type/id does not exist it may be created empty. POST /api/v2/chat/channels/{type}/{id}/query.

tools.name: stream_search_messages
tools.description: Search messages across channels. Scope with a channel filter (filter, e.g. {"type":"messaging"}) plus EITHER a full-text `query` OR a `message_filter` object (e.g. {"text":{"$q":"refund"}}). GET /api/v2/chat/search.

tools.name: stream_get_message
tools.description: Fetch a single message by its id. GET /api/v2/chat/messages/{id}.

tools.name: stream_get_replies
tools.description: Fetch the reply messages in a thread, given the parent message id. GET /api/v2/chat/messages/{parent_id}/replies.

tools.name: stream_get_reactions
tools.description: List the reactions on a message. GET /api/v2/chat/messages/{id}/reactions.

tools.name: stream_query_members
tools.description: List/filter the members of one channel. Requires the channel type + id. Optional member filter, e.g. {"name":{"$autocomplete":"jo"}}. GET /api/v2/chat/members.

tools.name: stream_query_users
tools.description: List/filter users in the app. e.g. filter {"role":{"$eq":"admin"}} or {"id":{"$in":["u1"]}}. GET /api/v2/users.

tools.name: stream_query_threads
tools.description: List threads (messages with replies). Server-side calls should pass a user_id to scope thread read-state to that user. POST /api/v2/chat/threads.

tools.name: stream_get_unread_counts
tools.description: Fetch total and per-channel unread message/mention counts for one user. GET /api/v2/chat/unread.

tools.name: stream_send_message
tools.description: ⚠️ WRITE: post a new message to a channel, attributed to user_id (must be an existing user in the app). POST /api/v2/chat/channels/{type}/{id}/message.

tools.name: stream_send_reaction
tools.description: ⚠️ WRITE: add a reaction (e.g. "like", "love") to a message, attributed to user_id (must be an existing user). POST /api/v2/chat/messages/{id}/reaction.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "stream_get_app" references sensitive artifacts (credentials). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

evidence.snippet: Fetch the Stream app's settings and configured channel types. Good first call to confirm credentials and discover available channel types. GET /api/v2/app.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: stream_query_channels, stream_get_channel, stream_search_messages, stream_get_message, stream_get_replies, stream_get_reactions, stream_query_members, stream_query_threads, stream_get_unread_counts · Private data: stream_get_app · Public sink: stream_query_channels, stream_get_channel, stream_query_threads, stream_send_message, stream_send_reaction.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: stream_query_channels, stream_get_channel, stream_search_messages, stream_get_message, stream_get_replies, stream_get_reactions, stream_query_members, stream_query_threads, stream_get_unread_counts · Private data: stream_get_app · Public sink: stream_query_channels, stream_get_channel, stream_query_threads, stream_send_message, stream_send_reaction

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
